summary: Serve System One decision requests in subllm-proxy with local Ollama Qwen3.5 fallback

delivery.outcome: Serve System One typed decision requests (/v1/decide and /v1/system-one/decide) in subllm-proxy using local Ollama Qwen3.5 models with governed SubLLM route fallback.
nonGoals: No edits to src/subllm/policy.py or subllm.toml while ticket-148 reserves those paths.
No edits to src/subllm/policy_config.py while ticket-145 reserves that path.

architecture.decision: Add /v1/decide and /v1/system-one/decide POST handlers in src/subllm/proxy.py that score System One questions via local Ollama Qwen3.5 (with think=False and format=json) or fallback SubLLM routes and normalize probability distributions.
interfaceChanges: Expose POST /v1/decide and POST /v1/system-one/decide on subllm-proxy
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-149 commit through protected publication.

validation.evidence: All tests in tests/test_proxy.py pass, governance-check.sh and wellman check pass with 0 errors.
